entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-06-22
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Extremely obscure bug with CollectionView and ItemsSource #30123
  • After cleaning the solution from VS, building/rebuilding does not generate the MauiSplashScreen image. #30120
  • [iOS] IndicatorView does not visually update dot indicators when the ItemsSource count changes #30118

Closed

  • Clean up copilot workspace #30112

PullRequests

Created

  • Introduce SetterSpecificity.FromUnknown to avoid misuse of FromHandler #30122
    community ✨
  • Integrate common ISensor interface #30121
    community ✨
  • [iOS] IndicatorView does not visually update dot indicators when the ItemsSource count changes - fix #30119
    platform/ios, area-controls-collectionview, community ✨
  • Fix update-cgmanifest.ps1 script to generate deterministic output #30117
  • Fix Android/iOS map polygon clearing issue by resetting MapElementId #30116

Merged

  • [XC] Fix detection of x:DataType from outer scope #30083
  • Xmlns perf #30096
  • Clean up copilot workspace after setup steps #30113

Updated

  • [iOS] Fixing #28912 by only hiding context buttons when user already stopped dragging the cell #28914
    area-navigation, platform/ios, community ✨, partner/syncfusion/review, .NET 9 Servicing
  • Avoid redundant property round-trips between platform and xplat across multiple controls #29970
    community ✨
  • Adopt DensityValue in Grid to Enable Precise Pixel-Aware Layout #30020
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 13330: Build ID 11809905 #30101
  • Skip useless handler mappings calls while connecting #27259
    community ✨, area-core-platform, .NET 9 SR9
  • [.NET10] Obsolete Page.IsBusy API #29935
    platform/windows, platform/android, platform/ios, community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • [.NET 10] Implement image compression & MaximumWidth/MaximumHeight for MediaPicker #30027
    t/breaking 💥, p/0, area-essentials-mediapicker, .NET 10.0-preview6
  • Move Blazor targets logic into conditional import to fix library project issues #30111
